description: List merge requests in a project. Returns array with localId, title, status, author, source/target branches.

author.description: Keep only MRs by this author username.

fields.description: Return only these top-level fields (plus id keys), narrowing the response further.

raw.description: Return the full, un-slimmed GitFlic response for THIS call (no token compression). Use when the default slim view dropped a field you need.

sourceBranch.description: Keep only MRs from a source branch matching this.

targetBranch.description: Keep only MRs targeting a branch matching this.

name: gitflic_mr_list
